grants.title: Connected apps
grants.description: AI apps (Claude, Cursor…) connected to your account over MCP. Disconnecting ends the app's access at once.
grants.revoke_description: {{name}} will no longer reach your Otopoly data. To reconnect, approve it again from the app.
grants.empty_description: Apps you connect, such as Claude, show up here.
scopes.read_hint_org: Customers, vehicles, jobs, sales, quotes, catalog, finance summary, todos and reports, as far as your permissions allow.
scopes.read_hint_platform: Organizations, users, subscriptions, AI usage, logs and system health (read only).
scopes.write_hint: Can create and update records such as customers, jobs, sales, payments and todos. The AI app asks you before every change.
guide.url_hint_org: Add this URL to your AI app as a custom connector. When connecting you sign in to Otopoly and choose the business.
guide.url_hint_platform: Use this URL for the platform administration tools. Only accounts with platform permission can connect.
guide.security_title: No password or API key is shared
guide.security_org: The connection uses OAuth and is bound to one business. The app works with your permissions only; you can disconnect it at any time.
guide.security_platform: The connection uses OAuth and is read only. Every tool call is written to the audit log.
guide.other_clients: Any MCP client that supports Streamable HTTP with OAuth connects with the same URL.
guide.clients.claude.title: Claude (claude.ai, desktop, mobile)
guide.clients.claude.step1: Open Settings > Connectors > Add custom connector.
guide.clients.claude.step2: Name it Otopoly, paste the MCP server URL above and press Add.
guide.clients.claude.step3: Press Connect; in the Otopoly window sign in, choose the business and press Allow.
guide.clients.claude_code.title: Claude Code
guide.clients.claude_code.step1: Run the command below in a terminal.
guide.clients.claude_code.step2: In a Claude Code session type /mcp and start authentication for the otopoly server.
guide.clients.claude_code.step3: Press Allow on the Otopoly consent screen that opens in the browser.
guide.clients.cursor.title: Cursor
guide.clients.cursor.step1: Open Settings > MCP > Add new MCP server (or edit ~/.cursor/mcp.json).
guide.clients.cursor.step2: Add the configuration below and save.
guide.clients.cursor.step3: Press Login next to the server and allow access in Otopoly.
guide.clients.vscode.title: VS Code (GitHub Copilot)
guide.clients.vscode.step1: Run MCP: Add Server from the command palette and choose HTTP.
guide.clients.vscode.step2: Paste the MCP server URL and name the server otopoly.
guide.clients.vscode.step3: VS Code starts the sign-in; press Allow on the Otopoly consent screen.
guide.clients.chatgpt.title: ChatGPT
guide.clients.chatgpt.step1: Turn on developer mode under Settings > Connectors > Advanced.
guide.clients.chatgpt.step2: Create a connector, paste the MCP server URL and choose OAuth as authentication.
guide.clients.chatgpt.step3: Sign in on the Otopoly consent screen and press Allow.
tenant.title: AI connections (MCP)
tenant.description: Connect Claude, Cursor and other AI apps to this business's data securely.
tenant.connections_hint: Only the connections you made are listed. Every user manages their own connections.
summary.title: What can the AI app do?
summary.org_intro: A connected app can read these areas of this business and, if you allow it, create records:
summary.platform_intro: A connected app can read this platform-wide data:
summary.rule_permissions: The app only works with your current permissions; when a permission is removed, so is the access.
summary.rule_one_org: Each connection is bound to one business; other businesses' data is never visible.
summary.rule_write: Tools that change data only run if you granted write access, and the app asks you every time.
summary.rule_read_only: The platform connection is read only; nothing can be changed.
summary.rule_audit: Every tool call is written to the audit log with personal data masked.
clients.title: Registered MCP clients
clients.hint: Every AI app registered through dynamic client registration. Blocking a client closes every user's connection to it.
clients.revoke_description: Every connection and access token issued to {{name}} stops working at once. This cannot be undone.
clients.empty_description: An AI app shows up here once it registers to connect to the MCP server.
platform.title: MCP server
platform.description: Connect the platform administration tools to Claude and other AI apps, and manage registered clients.
consent.title: {{client}} wants to access your Otopoly account
consent.description_org: If you allow it, the app works in the business you choose with your permissions.
consent.description_platform: If you allow it, the app can read platform administration data with your permissions.
consent.no_org_description: You may not connect AI apps in the businesses you belong to, or MCP connections are off in their plan.
consent.no_platform_description: This connection is for platform administrators only. Use the business URL for business data.
consent.footer: The app never sees your password. You can disconnect it at any time from the Connected apps tab of your profile.
consent.invalid_description: The request may have expired, been answered already, or the client was blocked. Start the connection again from the AI app.
